overview: Self-hosted event data platform that collects web and app events and routes them to warehouses in near real time.
description:
Jitsu is an open-source event data platform and Segment alternative. It collects events from websites, apps, and backend services, then routes them to data warehouses and downstream tools with near-real-time delivery. The console provides stream, destination, and pipeline management, while the ingest endpoint receives SDK and HTTP API traffic.

This package deploys Jitsu's official Docker Compose core stack: Console, Bulker, Rotor, Ingest, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, ClickHouse, and Redpanda. It is suitable for the upstream Compose-based core mode, but Jitsu documents that a feature-complete deployment since 2.14 requires Kubernetes for functions, profile builders, and connector sync jobs.

Typical use cases include customer data collection, warehouse-first analytics pipelines, event transformation, and self-hosted CDP deployments where teams need control over event delivery and storage.
